about: Measured full-load engine torque curves under redistributable licences. Values are stored verbatim from the cited tables: never smoothed, never extrapolated.

curves.condition: Full load (wide-open throttle), engine warm (coolant 82-88 C), hydraulic water-brake dynamometer, 0.5 m torque arm with load cell, speed stabilised before each reading

source.title: Design, Fabrication, and Performance Evaluation of a Locally Developed Automotive Engine Test Bed Using a Hydraulic Water-Brake Dynamometer
source.venue: International Journal of Mechanical and Civil Engineering (Global Publication House)
source.table: Table 4 - Measured torque, calculated brake power and exhaust temperature at full load

curves.notes: Attribution: measure data from the cited article, CC BY 4.0. The article reports peak 135.5 Nm at 3000 rpm; its own comparison notes this is 10.3% below the workshop manual figure for this engine (151 Nm at 2800 rpm), consistent with a locally built dynamometer and a high-mileage engine. Use as a measured reference curve, not as the absolute rating for a new engine.

gaps: Only one measured full-load curve was found that is both tabulated and redistributable. SAE/Elsevier tables, OEM service data, FSAE TTC/Calspan and commercial simulator maps are excluded by licence.
No measured BSFC/fuel map, torque-converter or thermal-derating data was found under a compatible licence.
